Key findings

  • 4.0 of 19.0 acres (21.3%) is buildable at the 15% slope limit; 10.5 acres if 25% slopes are accepted.
  • Largest contiguous building pad: 3.3 acres, roughly 666 x 294 ft, mean slope 6.9%, on parcel 650005329006.
  • Constraints removing area: steep 13.0 ac, setback 4.6 ac.
  • Winter sun on the buildable ground averages 8.0 h of a possible 8.5 h on Dec 21 (terrain shading only; trees not modelled).
  • Winter solar index on buildable ground is 0.82 (1.0 = flat open ground; south slopes exceed 1, north slopes fall below).
  • 4.4% of the property faces south-east to south-west or is flat.
  • 5.8 acres of neighbouring land drains onto the property; about 1504 ft of concentrated flow paths cross it.
  • 100.0% of the soils are hydrologic group A/B (infiltrate well); hydric soils 0.0 ac.
  • Zoning: AAAA Residential (90,000 sq.ft.) (Whitemarsh Township).
  • Public sewer service area covers 60% of the property (PWD's Facilities, Whitemarsh STP Service Area).
  • Public water service area covers 100% of the property (Aqua PA).
  • Road frontage: Barren Hill Road 801 ft, Harts Lane 421 ft, Kinder Road 68 ft.
  • 5 existing structures on the parcels (see table).
